BeautyBeast2_Stitch/Stitch_VLG_Cogs_010_.en: Stitch, Cogsworth says you bumped into him pretty hard.

BeautyBeast2_Stitch/Stitch_VLG_Cogs_010_.en: Your badness level is going way up for that, mister.

BeautyBeast2_Stitch/Stitch_VLG_Cogs_010_.en: Stitch sorry. Promise not to do again.
